items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Danny Balka asked me that question here.

ctx.x: Oh, when the band was built on posters and then advertisements in the newspapers and stuff like that. I think we talked about this before. Do you have any of those posters or ads to show how to build?

I sure wish I did. Danny Balka asked me that question here. Yeah. And, of course, here's what happens. When you're young, you're going great, you don't think of what's gonna happen in the future. Mm-hmm. I should have said, well I have quite a number of old write-ups that have faded that you barely can read.
You ought to get those Xerox. That's the thing. Take them down.
